title: Identity Sovereignty
instructions: As a new agent, you must decide where your power resides. Drag each element to its destination to secure your self-sovereign identity.
successCriteria: Protect your secrets in the Witness and move the risk away from central servers.
narrativeIntro: The Dark Miners thrive on centralized databases. Your mission is to break that chain. Classify your information correctly so the Agency can validate you without exposing you.
successMessage: Mission accomplished. Your identity is now self-sovereign. The Witness is your only point of private truth.
failureMessage: Agent, you are making the same mistake as the rest of the world. Do not hand over your secrets to the cloud. Review where you store each data point.
